primary_comparison: Bund PR cross-fitted abnormal log bipower proxy; same EA external equity coordinate and generation PR control Schatz scale
nuisance_harmonization: previous five non-event control days in both eras; generation retains 2022 clock dummy, historical dummy identically zero; separate era control fits; leave-year-out
state_for_cross_epoch_contrasts: pre-PR log BV standardized on generation PR Bund controls, fixed across eras; native LOYO state retained for within-era replication
angle_reference: uniform cone angular mean at state zero; model-dependent, not automatically identified across all angles
common_support_diagnostic: intersection of convex hulls in abs(u), abs(z), common state across 4 era-sector cells; axis points excluded from sector labels; >=8 retained per cell; no density guarantee
standardized_sector_contrast: balanced 4-cell common empirical distribution of abs(u),abs(z),state, evaluate sign-discordant and concordant predictions; infer conditional on empirical target
decomposition: symmetric exact Oaxaca decomposition of fitted sector gap difference into observed design composition and fitted coefficient response; full sample and common support; not causal; full support can extrapolate
inference: 19999 restricted meeting wild draws for two-sided tests; unrestricted wild-t 95% intervals; conditional on normal outcomes, regressors, support and target. Exploratory Holm over all 4 bases times 3 era/era-difference cone tests, and separately same 12 empirical standardized tests. No equivalence margin declared.
prohibitions: no treating non-rejection as equivalence or composition evidence
no new raw-data read or overwrite of prior results
